name: B10-0537/2025 (ECR) – Rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and calling for action. It asks Tunisia to release Sonia Dahmani, a lawyer held since May 2024, and everyone else jailed only for speaking out or joining groups. It says Tunisia's emergency decree on online speech has led to more prosecutions of journalists and activists. It urges Tunisia to protect free speech, free assembly and independent courts, and says respecting these rights matters for the EU–Tunisia partnership.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament only states its position and makes demands.
- **Who it affects:** Tunisia's government, its courts, and people jailed for speaking out.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends the text to EU bodies and Tunisia's leaders; no action is required.
